headline: Fair Isaac (FICO) Could Be 22% Undervalued As Earnings Come Into Focus
summary: Wall Street expectations for year over year earnings growth at Fair Isaac (FICO) have put the upcoming July 29 quarterly report in focus, with attention on how results align with these forecasts. See our latest analysis for Fair Isaac. At a share price of $1,206.19, Fair Isaac has seen short term share price pressure, with the 1 day and 7 day share price returns both declining, even as the 30 day and 90 day share price returns are positive and longer term total shareholder returns over three...
